name: nuPlan
tagline: Motional's large-scale planning dataset with more than a thousand hours of auto-labelled logs, HD maps and a closed-loop simulator, from four cities.

papers.title: Towards learning-based planning: The nuPlan benchmark for real-world autonomous driving
nuPlan: A closed-loop ML-based planning benchmark for autonomous vehicles

availability.eligibility: Non-commercial use under the nuPlan terms; the licence file sits next to the archives in the bucket.

evidence.note: The public S3 bucket answers anonymously; py123d downloads logs, maps and sensor shards from it without credentials.

download_size.note: Logs and maps for train, val and test. The mini set is about 11 GB. Camera and LiDAR shards add hundreds of GB per split.

history.event: First public release (v0.x) with the planning devkit.
v1.1 logs and sensor blobs for a 120-hour subset; nuPlan Challenge at the CVPR 2023 workshop.

scale.notes: Motional quotes about 1,282 hours; the figures here are measured by py123d from the released v1.1 databases. About 120 hours carry camera and LiDAR data.

sensors.name: surround cameras
sensors.notes: Released for the 120-hour sensor subset only.

sensors.name: merged point cloud
sensors.notes: Shipped as one merged point cloud per sweep; released for the sensor subset only.

annotations.notes: Auto-labelled tracks; some boxes are noisy.
Inferred from vehicle movements, so labels can be wrong.

splits.name: mini
splits.notes: Smoke-test subset with its own train, val and test partition.

benchmarks.name: nuPlan Challenge 2023 (closed-loop planning)
benchmarks.notes: The challenge concluded in 2023; the devkit simulator keeps working offline.

devkit.name: nuplan-devkit
devkit.notes: Last tagged release v1.2; pinned dependencies (SQLAlchemy 1.4) age badly.

loaders.name: NAVSIM
loaders.notes: Builds its benchmark on nuPlan logs.

known_issues: Synchronisation offsets between sensors and ego state in the sensor subset.
Sensor shards are uncompressed tar archives despite their .zip name and hold about 150 million files.

py123d.notes: nuplan-tar reads camera images and LiDAR sweeps straight from the downloaded sensor archives after indexing them once.

relations.note: Same organization and terms of use.

sensor_timeline.caption: Sensor recording timeline of the nuPlan mini split, as measured by py123d.

curation.notes: Release dates of v0.x and v1.1 should be confirmed against the devkit changelog. Split sizes are not recorded.
